messages.content: Hi, I ordered a MacBook Pro and tracking says it was delivered on Jan 18 but I never received it. I was home all day. Can you help?
I'm sorry to hear that. The FedEx tracking shows it was delivered to your front door. Have you checked with neighbors or your building management?
Yes, I checked with both neighbors and no one has it. My security camera was unfortunately offline that day. I've filed a police report.
I understand that's frustrating. Unfortunately from my end, the tracking confirms delivery and the address matched. I shipped the item properly and it was delivered by FedEx.
